metric_note: Spearman of board signal vs actual pick among board players matched to one drafted QB/RB/WR/TE (drafted-only conditioning). coverage = matched / drafted at position. round_hit = actual round inside the projected range (WF, CBS only). Pairs score both boards on the same drafted players; mean_rho_first is the first-named source. fallback_dropped = initial+surname+position hits refused because the pick is already claimed by an exact-name row on that board or the first names cannot be one person (review correction 7).
